# Bounty: Correct the stale fruit count in docs/inventory.md.

id bt-212eb1764bf7 · created 2026-10-13T13:50:53.547Z by box-bounty@0.1.0

## What is wanted

Correct the stale fruit count in docs/inventory.md.

docs/inventory.md says the pantry list holds five fruit, but
`node src/count.js` (run from the repository root) reports six. Change the
sentence in docs/inventory.md so the note agrees with the data and with what
the script prints — a one-line fix. Do not touch the list itself or the
script; the data is right, the note is stale.

## What was already tried

No public note was supplied.

## The code

Branch from `box-bounty/bt-212eb1764bf7` — it is the branch pull requests for this bounty target.
The branch is based on commit 32acfd1d26c25080537e744dad1acba978bc19e2, the newest commit this repository already had: it points at that commit — nothing new was published.

## How to answer

Fork this repository (or push a branch inside it), branch from `box-bounty/bt-212eb1764bf7`, make the change, and open a pull request against `box-bounty/bt-212eb1764bf7` in this repository. Collecting an answer runs nothing you wrote — the poster reads the change and decides.

Nobody is known to be watching these issues yet. Anyone can read this issue and the branch, and any account may answer.
